svg.title: Kamchatka 2025 earthquake in GRACE-FO
svg.text: The 2025 Kamchatka earthquake in GRACE-FO, against the USGS fault model
COST-G monthly gravity, degree ≤ 60, 300 km Gaussian, no destriping. Step at 29 July 2025, fitted with trend, seasons and a post-event ramp.
b. USGS fault model, same filter (µGal)
Colour limit ±3.7 µGal on both maps; blue more mass, orange less. ★ epicentre; circle: the cell charted in c.
d. Model amplitude α: Kamchatka against 100 ocean points
S1 detection: largest |step| within 500 km 3.47 µGal at 52.5°N 153.5°E
S2 after-slip: largest |ramp| within 500 km 3.91 µGal/yr (at the S1 cell +1.25)
S3 model match within 1500 km: amplitude α = 0.91 ± 0.16 (null rms), rank p = 0.010
